camel_example: aliyun nas DescribeLifecyclePolicies --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/abc/' --LifecyclePolicyName lifecyclepolicy_01 --StorageType InfrequentAccess --Description '描述' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --LifecyclePolicyId 'lc-xxx' --FileSystemId 31a8e40000 --LifecyclePolicyType Auto
description_en: Retrieves the list of lifecycle management policies
description_zh: 获取生命周期管理策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-lifecycle-policies --file-system-id 31a8e40000 --lifecycle-policy-name lifecyclepolicy_01 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --storage-type InfrequentAccess --lifecycle-policy-id lc-xxx --lifecycle-policy-type Auto --description '描述' --path /abc/ --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLifecyclePolicies

parameters.help_en:
The lifecycle policy name. Naming rules:


The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length, must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

Optional for General-purpose NAS file systems. If specified, this parameter takes precedence. If not specified, LifecyclePolicyId is used instead
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期策略名称。命名规则如下：


长度为3-64个字符，必须以大小字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。

通用型 NAS 文件系统选填，如果传入则以此为准，没有传入则以 LifecyclePolicyId 为准
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of lifecycle management policies on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每个分页包含的生命周期管理策略个数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the list.

Start value (default value): 1
parameters.help_zh:
列表的分页页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class.
Archive: Archive storage class.
If StorageType is not specified, all lifecycle policies are returned
parameters.help_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储。
Archive：归档存储。
如未指定 StorageType，则返回所有生命周期策略
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle policy
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The policy type.

Valid values:
Auto: Automatic execution.
OnDemand: On-demand execution.
Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略类型。

取值：
Auto：自动执行
OnDemand：按需执行
仅CPFS 智算版支持
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The description of the policy.
Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略的描述。
仅CPFS 智算版支持
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by path.
Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
根据路径筛选。
仅CPFS 智算版支持
parameters.name: path

LifecyclePolicies.description_en: The collection of lifecycle management policy information
LifecyclePolicies.description_zh: 生命周期管理策略信息集合

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the lifecycle management policy was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
CreateTime.description_zh:
生命周期管理策略创建的时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

DeleteRules.description_en: The file data expiration and deletion rules. A maximum of one rule can be configured
DeleteRules.description_zh: 文件数据过期删除规则，最多配置 1 个

items.description_en: The file data expiration and deletion rules. A maximum of one rule can be configured
items.description_zh: 文件数据过期删除规则，最多配置 1 个

Attribute.description_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Valid values:
Atime: The access time of the file
Attribute.description_zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间

Threshold.description_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
When Attribute is set to Atime, the value indicates the number of days since the file was last accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
Threshold.description_zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]

LifecyclePolicyId.description_en: The ID of the lifecycle policy

LifecyclePolicyName.description_en: The name of the lifecycle management policy
LifecyclePolicyName.description_zh: 生命周期管理策略名称

LifecycleRuleName.description_en:
The management rule associated with the lifecycle management policy.

Valid values:
DEFAULT_ATIME_14: Files not accessed in the last 14 days.
DEFAULT_ATIME_30: Files not accessed in the last 30 days.
DEFAULT_ATIME_60: Files not accessed in the last 60 days.
DEFAULT_ATIME_90: Files not accessed in the last 90 days
LifecycleRuleName.description_zh:
生命周期管理策略关联的管理规则。

包括：
DEFAULT_ATIME_14：距今14天未访问的文件
DEFAULT_ATIME_30：距今30天未访问的文件
DEFAULT_ATIME_60：距今60天未访问的文件
DEFAULT_ATIME_90：距今90天未访问的文件

Path.description_en: The absolute path of the single directory configured in the lifecycle management policy
Path.description_zh: 生命周期管理策略配置的单个目录的绝对路径

Paths.description_en: The list of absolute paths of multiple directories configured in the lifecycle management policy
Paths.description_zh: 生命周期管理策略配置的多个目录的绝对路径列表

items.description_en: The list of absolute paths of multiple directories configured in the lifecycle management policy
items.description_zh: 生命周期管理策略配置的多个目录的绝对路径列表

Attribute.description_en: The attribute of the retrieval rule

Threshold.description_en: The threshold of the retrieval rule

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class.
Archive: Archive storage class
StorageType.description_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储。
Archive：归档存储

Attribute.description_en: The attribute of the transit rule

Threshold.description_en: The threshold of the transit rule

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of lifecycle management policies on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的生命周期管理策略个数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of lifecycle management policies
TotalCount.description_zh: 生命周期管理策略总数
